tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Crestline Navy, the site's theme colour. Ground for social banners, the cover and hero bands. paper text on it reads 10:1.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The one accent. It marks where cash is stuck or leaking, and nothing else. As text: on surface in both themes (4.7:1 on paper, 6.1:1 on ink).

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Logo tint. Strokes and large text (24px+) on navy (3.6:1). Never small text on navy; use on-navy-accent.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand cream. Text on navy and ink; ground of the Paper theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Warm near-black. Text on paper; ground of the Ink theme.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules and dividers on paper. Decorative only (1.3:1); never the only thing that carries meaning.

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and mono labels on navy (5.4:1).

tokens.name: on-navy-accent
tokens.usage: Small orange text on navy, such as STUCK or LEAK tags (4.75:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface (17:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on surface (6.6:1 on paper, 7.0:1 on ink).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and table rules on surface. Borders, not shadows.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: See where your project cash is stuck.
styles.usage: Hero headlines on the site, decks and video title cards.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Banner and ad headlines, section openers.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Which clients pay slow, and why.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Crestline reads your ERP and shows which bills and payments hold up your cash.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: We read your books. We never write to them.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, process names, status tags. Always set in capitals.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Amounts, days and counts, with tabular figures so columns line up. Real product numbers only.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minor grid pitch; padding inside tags and chips.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Major grid pitch; section spacing; block sizes on covers and banners come in multiples of it.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Blocks, cards, banners: square, like a drawing sheet.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, tags. The most rounding a rectangle gets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Process nodes and status dots only.
